preparation_lock_fix.result: success on Intel macOS, Ubuntu and Windows; targeted preparation/bootstrap/archive fixtures plus native Bash/lifecycle/group checks

preparation_lock_fix.fix: Use protected AppSupport sibling lock without changing system runtime permissions; persist earliest full stdout/stderr and child/tee status; copy a completed report to one hash-matched volume and include root bootstrap originals in later export.
preparation_lock_fix.targeted_regression: Group-writable root:775 runtime directory accepted without touching it; pipeline failure code preserved, USB copies unique/no overwrite, bootstrap available before PLAN.
